summary: After upgrading to 2.6, administrators must verify team permissions in platform gateway and that merged accounts are the same person; gateway IAM becomes the source of truth, and hub and EDA users must be recreated or granted access. Verify login with controller admin credentials.
questions: What should I check after upgrading to AAP 2.6?
How do I verify the upgrade worked?
Which system is the source of truth for users after the 2.6 upgrade?

answer_card.title: Post-upgrade IAM checks
answer_card.answer_md:
- Verify permissions of every team in platform gateway right away.
- Confirm merged accounts really belong to the same person.
- Platform gateway IAM is now the source of truth for users.
- Recreate hub and EDA users, or grant moved controller users access.
- Log in with your existing controller admin username and password.
